runs.text: Great Projects Still Lose On A Rushed, Ugly Deck
Teams spend their last working hours in Figma instead of the pitch.
A generic template makes six months of work look like a class project.
Pasting a README into slides produces walls of text no judge reads.
Editing sixty text boxes by hand eats the last hour before demos.
Every teammate's slide looks like it came from a different deck.
Screenshots land at the wrong ratio and blur under the projector.
Nobody agrees on a palette, so the deck reads like three projects.
By the time slides look right, there is no time left to rehearse.
